reviews.author: Fenrick James
reviews.text: The team at Colosseum Construction did an amazing job with redoing our deck.  We had a specific requirement to mitigate ground chipmunks from eating through the wood and they found a solution.  I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Alyssa Hoskins
reviews.text: Lorne and his team have made my vision for my outdated 1970s home come to life. I was very impressed with their work and communication. I will be hiring them for more projects in the future!

reviews.author: Brian Kuntz
reviews.text: Colosseum Construction transformed our home with a stunning kitchen and bathroom renovation, plus some miscellaneous work. Their team was professional, reliable, and a pleasure to work with. The quality of their craftsmanship is top-notch. Highly recommend their services for anyone looking to elevate their space!

reviews.author: Daniel Cochran
reviews.text: Great contractor to work with. Got my paint and flooring needs done quickly

reviews.author: Andrew Gordon
reviews.text: I hired Colosseum to replace my roof and skylights in December 2024. My neighbor used them several months prior and was pleased with their work.  Despite having snow flurries the night before, Colosseum showed up in early AM and blew snow off roof to begin the replacement. They sent pictures via text to update me on progress as the roof was replaced. Pricing was very reasonable and the crew did a great job with cleanup afterward. Entire roof and 2 skylights were replaced in one day. Very pleased!

reviews.author: Gary Bates
reviews.text: Great job no hassle great job working with them

reviews.author: Greg Martin
reviews.text: Lorne, Kevin, and Mike (and the rest of the crew) are an incredible team! They are incredibly reliable, do a great job, good price, and are always willing to go that extra mile to make sure you’re satisfied. I highly recommend Coliseum Construction!

reviews.author: Mary Gary
reviews.text: rare and beautiful light dragon with vibrant, shining scales that seem to glow in the moonlight. With a kind and graceful demeanor, this dragon is a symbol of peace and harmony, serving as a protector and guide to those who treat it with respect. It's known for its incredible intelligence and wisdom, and is often sought out for its sage advice and guidance. Despite its formidable power, this dragon is gentle and compassionate, using its light magic for healing and rejuvenation, rather than for destructive purposes.

reviews.author: Kelly Huter
reviews.text: The crew was timely and finished the roof in a day. Several neighbors who have had new roofs in the last year have commented on ours looking so good. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Arthur Miller
reviews.text: Knowledgeable and polite helped renovated with new interactive Alexa ran home

reviews.author: Mark VanSant
reviews.text: They did a great job replacing rotted wood on my house and repairing facia boards.  Then painted the exterior.  The job was done to perfection.  I would highly recommend Colosseum for all home repairs.
reviews.ownerResponse: Mark, You were a pleasure to work with.  I know you and your family will be able to enjoy your home much more now that the work has been completed.  Thanks for putting your trust in us and our crew.

reviews.author: Gregory Doublestein
reviews.text: Loren and Kevin rescued us by taking on the gutter and downspout portion of a roof replacement due to a hail storm this past summer.  The original contractor was not able to complete the job and we were stranded.  Colosseum Construction stepped up despite being very busy with other projects and saw to it that the job finally got finished.  Their crew did an excellent job and in a timely fashion.  They were very responsive to our questions and patient with our indecision about color and previously planned trips out of town.  Really, the quality was excellent and the attention to detail was the icing on the cake.  Though ours was not as complex a job as a kitchen or bath remodel, they were willing to help us out of a bad situation and we are very grateful indeed.  Thank you Loren and Kevin!!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks, Greg  Glad we could help you guys out.

reviews.author: Tom tom5327f
reviews.text:
All A-1.  Only issue, but not major is on time, but that is because of material shortage.  Not their fault.
Overall VERY satisfied.

reviews.author: Justin Hogue
reviews.text: They did my master bathroom remodel and fixed my backyard deck. They did an amazing job, the crew was super friendly and were very professional. I will definitely be using them again when we're ready to remodel or kitchen!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks for the review Justin.  We really appreciate your business.

reviews.author: Wade Jackson
reviews.text:
We worked with Ray at Colosseum Construction and are very happy with the work that was completed.  They did a really nice job.  We appreciated how Ray and the contractors listened to our wants for the bathroom and gave practical advice that fit within our budget.  They helped us design the new bathroom and made our dreams a reality.

We liked them so much that we had them redo our kitchen as well!  We're very glad they did.  We would recommend them to anyone looking to do high quality home remodeling at a reasonable price.

Attached is after photos of the bathroom, and also a before/after photo of the kitchen.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks for the Review.  We appreciated the chance to work with you.  The Bath and Kitchen Look great..

reviews.author: Crystal Jackson
reviews.text:
I love my new roof.  It looks excellent.  Colosseum Construction did a great job.  Everyone was very professional, efficient and friendly.
I have dealt with another roofing company, and I must say that Colosseum was much more reasonable in their pricing.  They know what they are doing.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks, Crystal.  We appreciate your review and hope to be of service to you in the future as well.

reviews.author: Andrew Fillmore
reviews.text: The guys at Colosseum were very professional and we were very pleased with their work. They were always available when we needed them or had questions. They didn’t make us wait! We had to tear the roof of our our century old home and they did a beautiful job rebuilding and making it a beautiful home. They are kind and work hard at making everything go smoothly! We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Collin Brand
reviews.text: Colosseum Construction was incredibly fair and professional. My project was completed in a timely manner and the communication and customer service was perfect. Thanks Lorne!

reviews.author: brian qian
reviews.text: The company has a few drawbacks but in all, it is still good

reviews.author: Marilyn Rasche Juhlin
reviews.text: After Raymond came to my house to give me an estimate for my guest bathroom update, I found out that they could also help me with a wooden retaining wall in my back yard.  The workers who built the new wall were very helpful with their suggestions and ways to make the wall 'better than before'.  My bath update was scheduled for after Labor Day.  Raymond was very helpful in guiding me in my choice of tub, shower wall, sinks, and lights.The men were very understanding when I asked for a few days 'off' during a very hectic week.  Ray came up to the house several times to check on things and several times reminded me that they work for me and for what I wanted, not the other way around.  I appreciate his understanding when we had to change the shower dish container.  The gentleman that did most of the work was Arthur and his work is outstanding!  I would give him five stars as well as Raymond and the company!  I appreciate all they did to keep areas clean and clear of tools and materials.  I am most happy with my new guest bath and small half bath!!!!!!!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks for the review Marilyn, We think Arthur and Raymond are the best too.  Thanks for trusting us with your remodel work.

reviews.author: Max Mueller
reviews.text:
I searched high and low for a contractor that I felt comfortable with doing business with and when I was almost finished looking and going to give up on the project I realized there was this company just right up the road from me. I went in and from the start very kind and professional.  They listened to my issues and together we found the proper flooring and a remedy for my foryer.
But before the floors they have replaced my old leaky patio doors and also fixed some other issues that I was totally un aware of.
These guys are great and I strongly recommend giving them a go. You won't regret it.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thanks for the Review Max.  You guys were great to work with and your house looks great.....

reviews.author: Mary Stutler
reviews.text: We are very pleased with the carpet work of Ralph and Austin. They arrived at the expected time and were ready to get started. Their work ethic was admirable...they worked continuously until the job was complete. At numerous stages they asked if we were pleased with their work and if we had any questions or comments. Throughout the process they explained to us what they were doing and why. We are extremely satisfied with their work and will not hesitate to recommend them to anyone. We had a very good experience.

reviews.author: Andy M
reviews.text:
These guys are as good as it gets. I met Lauren the owner and Ray for  quote for total bathroom remodel. The quote was thorough and accurate. I was presented with options and agreed upon reasonable terms.

The crew of Tom and Tim were simply outstanding. On time each morning, both guys provided timely, professional and over all great service. They were easy to work with, we had great communication which made the process less stressful.

Here's the real deal about Colosseum, I had contact with all of them during the entire process. They answered the phone when I called and took my concerns and thoughts to heart.

I highly recommend Colosseum Construction for any construction/remodel/flooring/plumbing.
reviews.ownerResponse: Andy, It was a pleasure working for a client like you.  You made our job easier.  Thanks for putting your trust in us.  Tom said he wished all our clients were like you.

reviews.author: Diana Curts
reviews.text:
We were glad you were recommended  by our insurance. We were quite happy  with  your  work and how clean you left it. We didn't  even get a second  estimate,  yours seemed quite fair. Would recommend  your company . Thanks for a quality job!
Dennis and Diana  Curts
..
reviews.ownerResponse: Diana:  Thanks for trusting us with your roof replacement.  We appreciate you taking the time to write a review.  Thanks again.

reviews.author: Kimmy R2606
reviews.text: Colosseum Construction installed new siding, gutters, patio door, and entry door. I am very impressed with the quality of their work and how quickly they were able to finish the project. The staff showed up on time and did wonderful job keeping work area tidy. I would highly recommend Colosseum for any of your remodeling work.
